_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC. The wire shape InstrumentEntry actually declares (partName / experimentId / dataIsCollectable, partId a string) instead of the legacy partTitle / expId / hasData every other fixture here carries, and the first one where an instrument HOLDS something: two of the three read as collectable, the goo canister has been run and is not rerunnable, and science.experiments is non-empty so the vessel-wide data total in the subtitle has a figure to sum. Both were previously unrenderable from a fixture: the canonical parse branch was never fed, and an empty experiments list made sumExperimentDataAmount return 0, which suppresses the total entirely. science.lab is deliberately absent: this is a probe vessel, so the lab section stays away and the instrument list is the whole picture.
